simple.meaning: פַּח (pach) is a Hebrew animal word meaning “a (metallic) sheet (as pounded thin); also a spring net (as spread out like a lamina).” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Exodus 39:3. The surrounding context includes family, land.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to פַּח (H6341) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.

A snare will take him by the heel.

Keep me from the snare which they have laid for me,
Look on my right, and see;

For man also doesn’t know his time. As the fish that are taken in an evil net, and as the birds that are caught in the snare, even so are the sons of men snared in an evil time, when it falls suddenly on them.
He will be a sanctuary, but for both houses of Israel, he will be a stumbling stone and a rock that makes them fall. For the people of Jerusalem, he will be a trap and a snare.
Fear, the pit, and the snare, are on you who inhabit the earth.

It will happen that he who flees from the noise of the fear will fall into the pit; and he who comes up out of the middle of the pit will be taken in the snare; for the windows on high are opened, and the foundations of the earth tremble.

definitions.full: H6341. pach I. מַּח noun masculine Psa 124:7 bird-trap (compare Wilkinson Egyptians (1878) ii, 103, 109 f. Dr Amos 3:5 Hoffm ZAW iii (1883), 101 ); **compare also Baldensperger PEF 1905, 38 ( pahµ used now of a trap with a net). — ׳פ absolute Hosea 5:1 +, מָּ֑ךְ Jer 48:44 +; construct מַּךְ Hosea 9:8 +; plural מַּחִים Jer 18:22 +; — 1 literal פ ׳יַעֲלֶה Amos 3:5 b (as metaphor; v:a strike out ׳פ ), Prov 7:23 ; Eccl 9:12 (with אָחוּז ; both in simile). 2 usually figurative (sometimes || צַמִּים רֶשֶׁת, מוֺקֵשׁ, ): a. of calamities and plots , ׳פ יָקוֺשׁ Hosea 9:8 , compare Psa 91:3 ; 124:7 ; ׳פ alone Jer 48:43 = Isa 24:17 ; Job 22:10 ; Psa 124:7 ; Prov 22:5 ; פ ׳טָמַן לְ Jer 18:22 ; Psa 140:6 ; 142:4 ; פ ׳נָחַן לְ 119:110 , פ ׳יָקַשׁ לְ 141:9 ; פ בְּעָקֵב ׳יאֹחֵז Job 18:9 ; בֵּמּ ׳יִלָּכֵד Jer 48:44 = Isa 24:18 . b. = source or agent of calamity Hosea 5:1 ; Josh 23:13 (D), Isa 8:14 ; Psa 69:23 . — 11:6 see מֶּחָם . below II. [ מַּח ] noun [masculine] plate of metal ; plural פַחִים רִקֻּעֵי Num 17:3 ; construct הַזָּהָב אֶתמַּֿחֵי וַיְרַקְּעוּ Exod 39:3 . פחם (√ of following; compare probably Arabic be black , Late Hebrew מָּחַם id. (in derived species), מֶּחָם = Biblical Hebrew; Arabic charcoal ; Assyrian pêntu (= * pêmtu ) glowing coal ; Syriac in Lexicons).
